nature: Editorial index of three native matrices. Their differing dimensions and qualifications are preserved; no common voting grid, vote counts, novelty score, or empirical independence is inferred.

implementation_classes.support_antichain: Finite propositional sufficient-support antichains; mathematical interpretations and real Lean grounding remain separate.
implementation_classes.concrete_grounding: Restricted interpreted term grammar with actual finite grounding and first-proof closure.
implementation_classes.behavioral_frontend: Restricted list-source interpretation and admissible observation-domain certificates with concrete Lean exports.
implementation_classes.diagnostic_and_semilinear: Finite typed grounding, first-proof closure, diagnostic leaves, and supplied semilinear observation images.

native_dimensions.scoped_evidence: Same-object evidence and exact scoped/contextual identity
native_dimensions.obligation_telescope: Unfinished work is conditional evidence with dependent order
native_dimensions.grounding: Finite term arena and theorem-instance generation separate from closure
native_dimensions.behavioral_composition: Relational contracts preserve actual intermediate values
native_dimensions.observation_adequacy: Positive transfer, coverage, and realized negative evidence are separate
native_dimensions.semantic_binding: Source correspondence and actual theorem semantics at the final target
native_dimensions.method_policy: Required derivation policy is separate from theorem truth and search hints
native_dimensions.conservative_kernel: Richer authoring discipline first, ordinary Lean kernel conversion
native_dimensions.matched_evaluation: Matched library/service/renderer controls and stopping rules

native_dimensions.core: Conservative Lean elaboration and proof acceptance; kernel changes require a measured reason
native_dimensions.anchor: Evidence about the same object, scoped to an actual context and preserved by checked transport
native_dimensions.structures: Structure and witness data selected separately from proof-only properties
native_dimensions.behavior: Relational/dependent behavioral consequence and composition at actual values
native_dimensions.bounded: Finite/budgeted inference with a stated grounding boundary
native_dimensions.observation: Explicit observation/transport guarantees and source-level realization boundaries
native_dimensions.leant: Exact-candidate proof-linked behavioral synthesis, distinct from receipt/association
native_dimensions.checker: Denotation, checker soundness, execution evidence and original-target bridge
native_dimensions.fidelity: Statement, required-method and kernel truth distinguished
native_dimensions.evaluation: Matched Lean baselines, artifact costs, held-out tasks and substantive stopping rules
native_dimensions.frontier: Alternative sufficient support sets and the distinction between route soundness and coverage
native_dimensions.admissibility: Completeness on the actual admitted observation image

anchors.excerpt: A checker theorem about an encoded polynomial is not enough without the bridge between that encoding and the original source expression. Atom identities, variable order, coefficient ring, and arity are checked before combining coefficient arrays. Matching display names or relying on a digest as a proof of equality is insufficient.

Alder.qualification: Inclusion-minimal offered supports with immutable proof DAGs, lexical scope, separate replay, and conditional propositional export. Starts from ground opaque atoms; it does not bind arithmetic or analytic rules to Lean semantics.

Bryony.qualification: Inclusion-minimal offered supports and exact full-snapshot proof-tree replay with conditional propositional export. First proof retained per equal support; general dependent grounding and mathematical registration are proposed.

anchors.excerpt: \subsection{Checking and reification have different soundness obligations}

Clover.qualification: Source-derived endomorphism arena and goal-triggered grounding over seven concrete semantic rules. Retains one proof per atom and immediate unresolved routes, not minimal support families. Export/Lean acceptance and complete-document status remain separate.

Fennel.qualification: Named proof-root support antichains with implemented rule allowlists, proof replay, and capped partial outcomes. Registry atoms are opaque and Lean exports have explicit implication hypotheses; no real Lean grounding.

anchors.excerpt: \subsection{Three acceptable routes and one forbidden shortcut}

Heather.qualification: Restricted list language, affine interpretation, admissible-domain certificates and concrete negative witnesses/Lean goals. Its small readiness resolver is not a general antichain engine, and exported source correctness is distinct from model acceptance.

Juniper.qualification: Offered-support antichains with distinct conditional-derivation and finite-coverage checking; interrupted runs retain sound routes without claiming complete globally minimal inventories. Supplied Lean export is generic implication assembly.

anchors.excerpt: Fix a finite set $V$ of atoms, a set $K\subseteq V$ of known facts, a set $O\subseteq V$ of propositions allowed to appear as residual obligations, and a finite set of Horn rules

Laurel.qualification: Minimal residual-support frontiers over ground opaque atoms, independent replay and honest partial-result limits. No general Lean theorem grounding; an empty export carries no theorem evidence.

\subsection{A complete affine criterion on supplied semilinear images}

Rowan.qualification: Finite typed generation and first-proof closure plus diagnostic leaf frontiers and semilinear image checks. A diagnostic leaf list need not be a sufficient support; supplied image/candidate models are not a verified source bridge. No Lean file supplied.

anchors.excerpt: \subsection{A residual telescope is not a set of suggestions}

Sorrel.qualification: Total-assumption support antichains and replayable conditional plans, with missing premises computed relative to available facts. CLI route selection and budgeted-family wording require the scoped corrections documented by the review.
